qrcodegen.c and qrcodegen.h are unmodified Project Nayuki QR Code generator
v1.8.0 C sources, under the MIT license included in each file.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c

The distribution also includes assets/QR-CODE-LICENSE.txt. The shell encodes
only the temporary local setup URL, never an API key or account password.
